Jerry Stiller arrives on the street as himself to help Kippi Ben Kippod restore the missing letters by hosting a telethon. Stiller and Kippi work through the complete Aleph-Bet, soliciting letter pledges from special guest celebrities including Nell Carter, Tracey Gold, Anne Meara, Jeremy Miller, Itzhak Perlman, Joan Rivers, and Melissa Rosenberg.
